SELECT t.*, CONCAT(fa.code, ' ', fa.name) AS from_account_name, CONCAT(ta.code, ' ', ta.name) AS to_account_name, v.voucher_no, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM fin_fund_transfer t LEFT JOIN fin_account fa ON fa.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN fin_account ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id LEFT JOIN fin_voucher v ON v.id = t.voucher_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.create_by
AND (t.transfer_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND t.transfer_date >= #{begin} AND t.transfer_date <= #{end}
ORDER BY t.transfer_date DESC, t.id DESC
